llm.summary: This is a markdown-only bug-review workflow that is coherent with its purpose and does not include hidden execution, credential access, persistence, or exfiltration behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill is for bug hunting, defect documentation, fix preparation, and verification; its instructions stay within code review, test planning, linters, and minimal patches.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger terms are broad and could activate during ordinary development conversations, and the language module tells the agent to use an expertise persona for credibility; both are usability/trust notes rather than evidence of hidden or malicious behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The reviewed artifact contains only markdown files and no install scripts. It references an upstream Claude Code plugin with commands, agents, hooks, scripts, and optional plugin installation, so that separate plugin should be reviewed independently.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Suggested commands such as tests, linters, static analyzers, and build checks are proportionate for bug review, but they can execute project-local code and should remain user-approved in untrusted repositories.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The reviewed skill files do not define background workers, hooks, credential/session access, privilege escalation, persistent memory, broad indexing, or automatic long-running behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this when you want an explicit bug-review workflow. Review any proposed patch, test, lint, or build command before it runs, especially on untrusted code. Treat the stated expertise persona as framing, not a professional credential, and evaluate the referenced external Night Market/Claude Code plugin separately before installing it.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger concern is valid as a scope/usability note, but the artifact-backed behavior is a disclosed bug-review workflow, not hidden high-impact activity.
[SQP-3] expected: Language-specific framing is related to code review, but the instruction to state a persona for credibility should be treated as advisory style guidance rather than a real credential claim.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal status is pending and provides no negative artifact-backed signal.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious findings, matching the markdown-only artifact review.
